messages:
oncall-bot: Paging oncall — canary in eu-west-1 for route /v1/generate (redwood-v2-small) showing error rate spike to 18% and 95th latency > 3s. Severity P1. @Alex you're oncall.
Alex: seeing it, loading the canary dashboard now :eyes:
Alex: looks like 50% of canary instances hit OOMs and rest have long GC pauses.
Priya: which deploy id? canary tag?
Alex: deploy id=deploy-2026-03-17-47, variant=B, 5% traffic. started ~1749996400.
Jamie: traffic ramped earlier than scheduled due to config bug in rollout controller. I can flip traffic but need confirmation for manual rollback.
Luis: customer-impact check — SIGMA customers on eu region report a few 500s, SLO alerting triggered. estimate ~200 requests failed in last 10m.
Alex: I'm going to scissors the canary traffic to 0% first (soft unwind) then run rollback if health doesn't recover.
Jamie: ack. flipping feature flag now: `feature-ff.canary-route: 0 -> 0` (was 5%).
Jamie: done. traffic shifted, monitoring now.
oncall-bot: Traffic shift executed by Jamie at 1749997712. Canary traffic = 0%.
Priya: good. next step: do we want immediate rollback to previous stable model or let ephemeral nodes drain?
Alex: prefer rollback to stable (deploy-2026-03-16-99) — we saw OOM patterns on variant B, likely memory regression in tokenizer cache tweak.
Luis: I'll notify support to stand by for customer comms if errors persist during rollback.
Jamie: rolling back via rollout-service: `rollout revert deploy-2026-03-17-47 --to deploy-2026-03-16-99 --namespace=prod-eu`
Jamie: running now. command output: 
```
Initiating rollback...
Waiting for pods to become ready...
Pod stable-1 ready
Pod stable-2 ready
Rollback complete: traffic now on deploy-2026-03-16-99
```
Alex: monitoring metrics. error rate dropping to baseline 0.6% and p95 latency back to ~180ms.
Luis: I'm sending brief to customers affected: short blip due to canary rollout, rollback executed, apologies.
Priya: can we capture the canary pods logs and attach to ticket? I'll open an issue for the tokenizer cache tweak.
Alex: grabbing logs and core dumps now: `kubectl logs --selector=app=redwood,version=deploy-2026-03-17-47 --since=20m > /tmp/canary-logs.txt`
Alex: uploaded logs to ticket INC-2026-3581 and attached stack traces.
SRE Rotation: leaving follow-up for postmortem and rollback checklist updates. assigning to Jamie and Priya. :memo:
Jamie: will add a guard in rollout controller to respect scheduled ramp and add a throttling safety.
Priya: will add regression test for tokenizer cache memory growth and a canary memory check in the autoscaler.
Alex: all clear from oncall perspective, marking incident as mitigated.
oncall-bot: Incident mitigated at 1749997810. If new regressions appear, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
